description: Python source code for a Bokeh-based monitoring dashboard class 'MastMonitor' that visualizes data from JSON files related to JWST and CAOM instruments, including data reading, processing, and plot updating methods.

classes.name: MastMonitor
classes.description: A class inheriting from BokehTemplate to create a monitoring dashboard for JWST and CAOM data, handling data loading, processing, and plot updates.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initial setup before the main initialization, setting embed flag, interface file, and configuration.

methods.name: post_init
methods.description: Post-initialization method to trigger plot updates.

methods.name: read_new_data
methods.description: Reads latest data from JSON files if they have been modified since last cache time.

methods.name: update_plots
methods.description: Updates data sources and variables for the monitor bar charts based on the latest data.
